listings.name: OK Furniture Mankweng Paledi Mall
listings.current_description: OK Furniture sells furniture, home appliances, flooring and electronics aimed at mid-income households, including lounge, bedroom and outdoor furniture alongside branded appliances and cellular products; this branch trades from Paledi Mall in Mankweng.

listings.name: Old Khaki
listings.current_description: Old Khaki is a South African casual-lifestyle clothing brand offering relaxed, durable clothing, footwear and accessories for men and women, from everyday essentials to outdoor-ready pieces, at its Mall of the North branch.

listings.name: Polokwane Place
listings.current_description: Polokwane Place is a 25-room guest house and conference venue on Burger Street offering Budget, Standard, Luxury and Executive rooms, two swimming pools, a lapa lounge, a tennis court and an on-site restaurant.

listings.name: Rocotta Brick Centre
listings.current_description: Rocotta Brick Centre is a bricks and building-materials supplier on the R71 Tzaneen Road at the Dalmada/Myngenoegen traffic circle, stocking plaster bricks, face bricks (FBS) and brick moulds for the building trade.

listings.name: Sentech
listings.current_description: Sentech is South Africa's state-owned broadcasting signal distributor, providing terrestrial and satellite signal distribution infrastructure for public, community and commercial radio and television broadcasters; this is its regional office in Eduan Park, Polokwane.

listings.name: Stewarts & Lloyds Polokwane
listings.current_description: Stewarts & Lloyds Polokwane is a steel and hardware branch supplying steel and tube products, pipes and fittings, valves, pumps, irrigation and fencing products to the Nirvana area, having opened in May 2022.

listings.name: Studio 88
listings.current_description: Studio 88 is the Mall of the North branch of South Africa's largest branded footwear and clothing retailer, an official reseller of international sneaker and sportswear brands such as Nike, adidas and Puma.

listings.name: Tax Saviour (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Tax Saviour (Pty) Ltd is an accounting and tax advisory firm, founded in 2017, offering accounting, taxation, consulting and business advisory services to businesses, individuals, trusts and non-profits from its Polokwane Central office.

listings.name: UFO Savannah Mall
listings.current_description: UFO Savannah Mall is a United Furniture Outlets showroom inside Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, offering couches, dining and lounge suites, beds, mattresses and home accessories from the furniture chain established in 2004.

listings.name: Aesthetico
listings.current_description: Aesthetico is a medical aesthetic clinic at The Eye Centre in Hospital Park, offering treatments such as anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, mesotherapy, chemical peels, dermapen needling and IPL laser treatments alongside beauty therapy services.

listings.name: Auto Electrical & Aircon Specialist
listings.current_description: Auto Electrical & Aircon Specialist is a Superbia-based auto electrical workshop offering vehicle wiring, electrical fault-finding and repairs, and air-conditioning installation and servicing; it is a member of the Motor Industry Workshop Association (MIWA).

listings.name: Baby City
listings.current_description: Baby City is a national baby-products retail chain, and this Mall of the North branch stocks baby clothing, nursery furniture, car seats, prams and other baby and toddler essentials, with Click and Collect available.

listings.name: Bargain Books
listings.current_description: Bargain Books at Savannah Mall is a branch of South Africa's leading discount bookstore chain, founded in 1998, known nationally for its wide range of bestsellers, children's titles and Afrikaans fiction at value prices.

listings.name: Bearings International
listings.current_description: Bearings International is the Polokwane branch of the nationwide Hudaco Group bearings and power-transmission distributor, stocking bearings, chain, sprockets, gearboxes and electric motors along with fitment and product training support for its Ladanna customers.

listings.name: Blesbok Inn
listings.current_description: Blesbok Inn is a bed and breakfast guesthouse in Fauna Park offering en-suite rooms with king-size beds, TV, bar fridge, microwave and free Wi-Fi, plus free secure parking, about 2km from Polokwane city centre.

listings.name: Bradlows Mankweng
listings.current_description: Bradlows Mankweng is the local branch of the long-established Bradlows furniture and appliance chain, stocking lounge, dining and bedroom furniture alongside home appliances and electronics inside Paledi Mall, with credit and lay-by purchase options.

listings.name: Clicks Limpopo Mall
listings.current_description: Clicks Limpopo Mall is a Clicks pharmacy and health-and-beauty store trading at the corner of Market and Rissik Streets inside Limpopo Mall (formerly known as Middestad Mall), offering a dispensary alongside its retail range.

listings.name: Freedom of Movement
listings.current_description: Freedom of Movement is a South African lifestyle brand, founded in Stellenbosch in 2013, with a store in Mall of the North, Bendor, selling apparel, footwear and leather goods including bags, sneakers and vellies.

listings.name: Galito's Ivy Park
listings.current_description: Galito's Ivy Park is a flame-grilled peri-peri chicken restaurant in Ivy Park Centre, part of the national Galito's chain, serving chicken in flavours from Lemon & Herb to Extra Hot alongside chips and sides.

listings.name: Gizara's Carwash & Cleaning Services
listings.current_description: Gizara's Carwash & Cleaning Services is a car wash and cleaning company on Church Street that has operated in Polokwane for over 20 years, with several branches across the city and one in Pretoria.

listings.name: Glass Doctor
listings.current_description: Glass Doctor is a windscreen replacement and repair franchise in Superbia, also handling side and rear glass replacement, chip repairs and vehicle glass checks, part of a national network with branches across several provinces.

listings.name: The Grace Terraces Guest House
listings.current_description: The Grace Terraces Guest House offers 11 en-suite rooms with DStv, free Wi-Fi and tea/coffee facilities, plus an indoor pool and a 24-hour front desk, about 2km from Savannah Mall in Flora Park.

listings.name: Image Travel and Tours
listings.current_description: Image Travel and Tours is a Polokwane travel agency offering flight bookings, cruise holiday packages to destinations such as the Mediterranean, Caribbean and Alaska, and safari and hunting tour packages alongside European tour itineraries.

listings.name: JaggerTech Industrial Supplies and Services CC
listings.current_description: JaggerTech Industrial Supplies and Services CC is an industrial and mining supplies business in Hospital Park, Polokwane, founded in 2003 and specialising in dust collector filters, industrial pump solutions and spares, and heat exchangers.

listings.name: Madulo Guest House
listings.current_description: Madulo Guest House is a guest house in Flora Park, about 5km from the Polokwane CBD, offering en-suite rooms with DStv and air-conditioning, a private garden, secure on-site parking, and an in-house beauty salon.

listings.name: Markham
listings.current_description: Markham is a menswear fashion retailer offering smart and casual wear, footwear, accessories and a denim range anchored by its own Relay Jeans label alongside brands like G-Star and Levi's, trading from Seshego Circle.

listings.name: MTN
listings.current_description: MTN is a South African mobile network operator; this Savannah Mall store sells SIM cards, contracts, devices and accessories, and handles account and support queries for customers in Fauna Park and the surrounding suburbs.

listings.name: Paint Pot Polokwane CC
listings.current_description: Paint Pot Polokwane CC is a paint and hardware retailer in Superbia with over 30 years in the paint trade, stocking primers, undercoats and matt and gloss enamel paints, with in-store colour tinting available.

listings.name: Pest Control Hygiene and Cleaning
listings.current_description: Pest Control Hygiene and Cleaning is a Flora Park-based pest control and cleaning company with 25 years' experience, offering termite proofing, insect and rodent treatment, and general cleaning services including carpets, floors and offices.

listings.name: Polo Guest House
listings.current_description: Polo Guest House is a guest house in Hospital Park offering air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, a swimming pool and garden, and a small conference venue, with breakfast included and dinner available on request.

listings.name: R and G Meat Supplier
listings.current_description: R and G Meat Supplier is a butchery on Plot 37 Dalmada, next to the Dalmada filling station, selling fresh A-grade meat including mince, boerewors, ox liver and poultry cuts, with delivery around Polokwane.

listings.name: Reclam Polokwane
listings.current_description: Reclam Polokwane recycles ferrous and non-ferrous metals along with paper, cardboard and plastic, and also runs a free garden waste and food waste drop-off that it turns into compost and lawn dressing for sale.

listings.name: Savannah Guest House
listings.current_description: Savannah Guest House is a guest house in Flora Park offering air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, TV and tea/coffee facilities, plus an outdoor swimming pool, garden and braai/fireplace area, and on-site parking.

listings.name: Sea Water Boutique Lodge
listings.current_description: Sea Water Boutique Lodge is an adults-only boutique lodge in Mankweng offering air-conditioned rooms with private balconies, a spa and wellness centre, and an on-site restaurant, along with free WiFi and secure on-site parking.

listings.name: Splash & Jump Zone Polokwane
listings.current_description: Splash & Jump Zone Polokwane is a water park and trampoline attraction on Plot 22, 1st Ave, Dalmada, featuring high-speed water slides, a lazy river, a children's pool area and a JumpZone trampoline park.

listings.name: Steers Total Fauna Park
listings.current_description: Steers Total Fauna Park is a flame-grilled burger and chicken outlet at the TotalEnergies Fauna Park fuel station, part of the Steers fast-food franchise chain, serving burgers, chicken and ribs for takeaway and drive-through.

listings.name: Turbo Tyres - Point S
listings.current_description: Turbo Tyres, trading as Point S Polokwane, is a tyre-fitment centre on President Paul Kruger Street offering tyre sales and fitment for cars, 4x4s and light commercial vehicles, along with wheel and accessory services.

listings.name: Vertex Boreholes
listings.current_description: Vertex Boreholes is a borehole drilling and installation company based in Bendor, offering complete solutions including borehole pumps, tank stands, water tanks, trenching and PVC/steel casing, serving Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region.

listings.name: Vertex Industries
listings.current_description: Vertex Industries manufactures and supplies borehole drilling rigs and equipment, including DTH and rotary drill rigs used for water drilling, mining and pole-hole applications, and also offers repairs and after-sales servicing on drilling machinery.

listings.name: Alert Steel Polokwane
listings.current_description: Alert Steel Polokwane, on the corner of Nikkel & Kobalt Street in Superbia, is one of six Alert Steel retail outlets serving greater Polokwane with steel and rebar products; the business dates back to 1997.

listings.name: Ambiance Restaurant
listings.current_description: Ambiance Restaurant is a restaurant and conference venue on Rabe Street in Polokwane Central, serving a lunch menu of dishes such as mutton stew, chicken schnitzel, quiches and filled pancakes, with call-and-collect and delivery available.

listings.name: Auto Magic
listings.current_description: Auto Magic in Superbia is an insurance-approved panel beating and spray-painting workshop handling dent and collision repairs for cars, bakkies and trucks, operating as part of the nationwide Auto Magic franchise network of insurance-approved repairers.

listings.name: Bakone Malapa Northern Sotho Open-Air Museum
listings.current_description: Bakone Malapa is a reconstructed open-air cultural village near Polokwane depicting traditional Northern Sotho life from roughly 250 years ago, with demonstrations of fire-making, maize grinding, beer brewing, pottery, wood carving, beadwork and basket weaving.

listings.name: Beauty of the Bride
listings.current_description: Beauty of the Bride is a bridal boutique in Standard Bank Square offering wedding gowns from local and international designers, available to buy or hire, with an optional wedding-day hair-and-makeup package arranged through partner suppliers.

listings.name: Biddulphs International
listings.current_description: Biddulphs International's Polokwane branch is a furniture removals and relocation company that also offers self-storage units in a range of sizes, plus palletised and transit storage warehousing, serving Polokwane, Tzaneen and the wider Limpopo region.

listings.name: BUCO Ga Thoka
listings.current_description: BUCO Ga Thoka is a hardware and building supplies store on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, stocking building materials, tools, electrical and plumbing supplies for contractors and DIY customers; it opened in November 2021.

listings.name: Cashbuild Madiba Park
listings.current_description: Cashbuild Madiba Park is a hardware and building-materials store at the Madiba Park Shopping Centre in Seshego, stocking cement, timber, roofing, plumbing, electrical and paint supplies, and offering free plan-reading and costing for building projects.

listings.name: COFI
listings.current_description: COFI is a restaurant and cafe at Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, serving an eclectic menu of bakery items, bistro dishes, seafood, steak and tapas alongside coffee, with outdoor seating and a bar on site.

listings.name: Debbie Mouton Jewellers
listings.current_description: Debbie Mouton Jewellers is an independent Polokwane jewellery retailer offering custom-made and hand-picked jewellery and premium watch brands including TAG Heuer, Rado and Raymond Weil, along with valuations and repairs, at its Savannah Mall store.

listings.name: Dis-Chem
listings.current_description: Dis-Chem is a South African pharmacy and health retail chain, founded in 1978, with a store in Mall of the North, Bendor, offering prescription medicines, health and beauty products, baby care and an in-store clinic.
